lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: Huff... huff... Damn, you hit way harder than you look.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: That was tough, Franky. Now step aside—the gate is opening.

lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: Heh, fair enough. You earned every bit of this path forward.

lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: Listen to me: the trials waiting on the other side are on a whole different level.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I'm ready for whatever comes next.

lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: That's the spirit! Go out there, kick some ass, and do it with a SUUUUPER blast!
